explanation:
The ball reaches maximum height when $-5t^2 + 20t + c = 25$ has exactly one solution, which occurs when the discriminant equals zero. Rewriting as $-5t^2 + 20t + (c-25) = 0$, we have $a=-5$, $b=20$, $c-25$ as constant term. The discriminant is $b^2 - 4a(c-25) = 400 - 4(-5)(c-25) = 400 + 20(c-25) = 400 + 20c - 500 = 20c - 100$. Setting this equal to zero: $20c - 100 = 0$, so $c = 5$.
